similarities.point: Both describe buzzard as a name applied to multiple species of hawk-like birds.
similarities.quote_britannica: BUZZARD, in anthology, the English name of fever-ral species of the hawk kind.
similarities.quote_wikipedia: Buzzard is the common name of several species of birds of prey.

differences.point: Britannica is a one-line entry with a cross-reference, while Wikipedia is a long list of species.
differences.quote_britannica: BUZZARD, in anthology, the English name of fever-ral species of the hawk kind. See Paxo.
differences.quote_wikipedia: Buzzard is the common name of several species of birds of prey.
